reason: In ASN1Decoder.readInteger (authz/client/.../util/crypto/ASN1Decoder.java, patch lines 119-121), a length byte of 0 makes read(0) return an empty array, and `new BigInteger(new byte[0])` then throws an unchecked NumberFormatException ("Zero length BigInteger"). Nothing checks for or wraps this, so it never becomes an IOException parse error, and asn1derToConcatenatedRS (AuthzClientCryptoProvider, patch lines 497-498) passes it straight to the caller.
